description: Validate unPaper HTML (or any HTML deck) BEFORE converting. Returns the conformance level (L0–L3), per-slide issues, and a ready fix-request text. Call after writing or editing a deck; if level < L1 or errors exist, apply the fixes and call again. A clean check makes `convert` output fully editable. Set template: true (with optional family) to validate a COMPANY TEMPLATE from `templatize` against the byte-law instead: per-rule checks, mechanical re-lock of a drifted sizing script, a fix request on failure, and the repaired html to save.

family.description: template mode only: the base family (default: auto-detected)

html.description: the deck as an HTML string

path.description: or an absolute file path — exactly one of html/path

template.description: validate as a company template (byte-law) instead of a deck

name: check
